name: Alice no Yakata
source:
A collection of additional materials including a new adventure story "Sentimental season".

The heroine dates a boy, but the relationship in the pair of her school friend Mami develops much more intensively and the heroine does not want to lag behind.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一部额外内容合集，其中包含新冒险故事《感伤季节》。

女主角正与一名男孩交往，可校内好友真美与男友的关系进展得远比她迅速，女主角也不想被对方甩在后面。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
